name: Loki Muspelheim
source:
The current head of Muspellzheimr, a tributary house to the imperial nobility which once held significant influence within the demon realm.

He lived his early life peacefully with his parents. However, one day his father was branded a rebel without cause, and was executed for his suspected crimes while his mother was incarcerated.

Loki was not executed, but was instead forced to give up his demonic armament which is considered a proof of inheritance to the throne.

After that, Loki was forced to live in the castle, ostracised and branded as the child of a rebel. However, Loki has now decided to participate in the feud for the throne.

Armed with his skill with the spear and tactical mind left behind by his deceased father, with the knowledge of magic and how to handle women taught to him by his maid, Fena...

And finally, primed with his ace in the hole, the power of the 『God of Armageddon』, he fights to win the feud for the throne.

「I will become the ruler of the demon realm. To that end, I'm willing to destroy every obstacle in my path!」
